layers.title: Authoritative watershed polygon registry
layers.description: WSC station-basin records for the pass-9 river set. Official packages are identified, but polygon geometry is intentionally null because binary ingestion failed.

layers.title: Authoritative river reach registry
layers.description: River research objects linked to official hydrometric anchors and authoritative hydrography sources. Line geometry remains null until GRHQ/Canada1Water data are actually ingested.

layers.title: DEM terrain profile status
layers.description: Tracks HRDEM readiness for each pass-9 reach. All terrain-drop and hydraulic-head fields remain null.

layers.title: Hydrometric observation profiles
layers.description: Official WSC station points and drainage-area metadata for 24 river references. Flow series/statistics are not fabricated and remain unpopulated until HYDAT/official series extraction.

layers.title: Hydro resource research reaches
layers.description: Unranked river research objects. These are not candidate dam coordinates and contain no invented head, design flow, MW, CAPEX or LCOE.

layers.title: Hydro reach logistics context
layers.description: Join/status layer for community, port, road and fibre research. It intentionally does not recreate prior generated map geometries that are unavailable in this runtime.

layers.title: Hydro atlas evidence completeness matrix
layers.description: Per-river evidence completeness for the Hydro Resource Atlas. Despite the legacy filename concept “opportunity”, this layer contains no opportunity/suitability score or ranking.
